description: This source file defines middleware for exception handling in an ASP.NET Core web application, capturing exceptions during HTTP request processing and returning appropriate JSON-formatted error responses.

classes.name: ExceptionMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware class for global exception handling that intercepts exceptions during HTTP request processing and returns JSON error responses.

methods.name: InvokeAsync
methods.description: Core method to invoke the next middleware in the pipeline and handle exceptions if they occur.

methods.name: HandleExceptionAsync
methods.description: Handles different types of exceptions and writes JSON error responses with appropriate HTTP status codes.
